However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.

programme.title: Khan-Daan
programme.desc: After the initial adjustment period of the pilot, the household faces its first major logistical crisis—Food. The episode explores the chaos of shared groceries, differing diets, and the "disaster" that is a communal refrigerator.

programme.title: Safai-Squad
programme.desc: After weeks of living together, the apartment has reached a state of "critical mess." Aashna (Kriti Vij), who takes pride in a clean and aesthetic home, finally snaps. The episode follows the couple's attempt to militarize the house cleaning process and the bachelors' hilariously lazy resistance.

programme.title: Family Ban Gayi
programme.desc: The episode begins with a sense of impending change. After weeks of chaos, the experimental living arrangement—where a married couple (Akash and Pooja) shares their home with three bachelors (Rohit, Mohit, and Vishi)—is put to the test.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: All Is Well
programme.desc: Maya’s impulsive decision leaves her awkward around Chirag, who doesn’t miss a chance to tease her. As they open up about their generational views on work and life, Maya reaffirms her belief in mental health and Thoda Sukoon’s mission. But just as things start looking up, a bold move in a high-stakes meeting sparks serious tension with the higher-ups. Can Maya recover when her values put her at odds with the very system she’s trying to change?

programme.title: The Breakdown
programme.desc: While the team scrambles to fix minor app bugs, the real issues at Thoda Sukoon are swept under the rug — until it all explodes. An employee collapses from overwork, triggering a full-blown social media backlash. As tensions rise, Maya and Chirag are forced to face unresolved conflict, and the team must ask: how far is too far? Can this crisis spark real change in a toxic work culture, or is it already too late?

programme.title: The Cliffhanger
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Riddhi's collapse, Zooni spearheads a desperate negotiation for better working conditions. As a seemingly balanced work environment emerges, the team struggles to deliver, and blurred lines between professional and personal lives begin to fray. Are these simply growing pains for Thoda Sukoon, or are fresh, explosive complications on the horizon?

programme.title: The Misfit
programme.desc: India’s fashion matriarch, Zahira, is making a bold move - bringing Zahiraan into the world of wearable luxury. But there’s a catch - neither she nor her team knows how to navigate this shift. Thus, comes in Ayesha - a rookie designer, a dreamer bursting with fresh ideas. But will she survive the cut-throat competition in fashion and at Zahiraan? Get ready for an intense drama, glamorous showdowns, and career-defining moments as the battle for success begins at Zahiraan.

programme.title: Time To Shine
programme.desc: Ayesha’s out-of-the-box ideas leave a mark on Zahira, but not everyone is impressed. As she tries to navigate the high-pressure world of fashion, her bold creativity ignites a war with her team. Amidst the chaos, an unexpected friendship with Sanchi gives Ayesha the confidence boost she desperately needs. But in an industry where talent isn’t enough, will this newfound support be her key to a major breakthrough?

programme.title: The Big Launch
programme.desc: The much-awaited Zahiraan launch is here, but disaster strikes! One unexpected error threatens to crumble Ayesha's hard-won validation from Zahira, and jeopardize both their careers. Meanwhile, Karan battles crippling self-doubt, wondering if he'll ever measure up to the perfection demanded by the high-stakes fashion world. Will their reputations survive?

programme.title: Perfect Shaadi
programme.desc: Aditya and Prajakta are all set to tie the knot! As they navigate the excitement and chaos of wedding planning, a surprise guest from Prajakta's past arrives, turning their perfect day upside down. Will love triumph over unexpected challenges?

programme.title: Basundi Ki Bhasudi
programme.desc: As Aditya and Prajakta celebrate their pre-wedding festivities, a shocking twist turns their world upside down! Will they handle the chaos together?

programme.title: Hum Tum Aur?
programme.desc: A perfect wedding, a hidden secret, and a love under threat. Will Aditya and Prajakta's love story survive the test of time?

programme.title: Bride Ka Best Man
programme.desc: As pre-wedding festivities unfold, Aditya stumbles upon a secret only Prajakta’s best friend knew. Can he handle the parts of her he’s just beginning to see?

programme.title: Imperfect Shaadi
programme.desc: The episode centers on the wedding of the lead couple, where everything seemingly goes wrong. However, instead of letting the chaos ruin the day, the couple realizes that the "imperfections" of their wedding reflect the reality of their relationship. They choose to embrace the mess, focusing on their commitment to each other.

programme.title: Infection
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Diagnosis
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Complications
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Surgery
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Recovery
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Honeymoon Period
programme.desc: The series introduces Nishant, Sakshi, and Huma as they begin their MBBS journey, adjusting to the demanding environment of medical college and forming new friendships.

programme.title: Donning
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Lockdown
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Critical Condition
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Fomo
programme.desc: Dhruv and Kavya plan a lazy Sunday but feel the pressure of missing out when they see their friends enjoying exciting activities on social media. This leads them to seek ways to spice up their day.

programme.title: Have A Nice Day
programme.desc: A morning rush to work results in a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling their moods. Throughout the day, they attempt to make amends, highlighting the irony and sweetness of their relationship.

programme.title: Good Night
programme.desc: A sleepless night due to mosquitoes leads to the discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, prompting a long conversation about their past relationships.

programme.title: Thank You!
programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Here We Go!
programme.desc: During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

programme.title: Masterji
programme.desc: Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

programme.title: Jaldi Lautna, Captain
programme.desc: Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

programme.title: Shooter Jawan
programme.desc: Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

programme.title: Sarhad Ke Baad Bhi
programme.desc: Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

programme.title: Bachelorhood
programme.desc: Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

programme.title: Kabab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

programme.title: (un)happy Birthday
programme.desc: Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?

programme.title: Mann Ki Rant
programme.desc: The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.

programme.title: Yaar Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

programme.title: Conflict Of Interest
programme.desc: Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

programme.title: Internal Politics
programme.desc: Adhira and Shagun are in a disagreement about whom to select for a wedding film promo: a boring aunt from the bride's side or a lively drunk aunt from the groom's family. Things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.

programme.title: Poaching The Talent
programme.desc: Vishnu, the Agarwal's househelp cum man friday is desired by the sisters as an office boy to help them sort out their business affairs. The parents are naturally opposed to the idea. Thus begins another standoff in the Agarwal household - and Vishnu's position in the house is at stake. Who will finally lay claim over Vishnu's priceless services?

programme.title: Business Secrets
programme.desc: In a footage from a wedding they just filmed, the sisters find a drunken confession from the bride's best friend. It turns out she is the groom's ex - and he hasn't told the bride to be. Caught in the moral dilemma of choosing to tell the bride or not, the sisters find themselves on other ends of the argument. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Adhira's father might have a similar secret hidden from everyone. Will the sisters do the morally right thing or the financially right thing? And what is the father's bizarre obsession with knowing who the groom's mom is?

programme.title: Breach Of Contract
programme.desc: Chasing a competitive business pitch to work for a coveted fashion firm, the sisters are again at different sides of a dilemma. The commitment to the new opportunity would be for a minimum two years, which Adhira is reluctant to make at the age of 25. Whereas Shagun, having already quit her high paying corporate job to join this business, sees no harm in seizing the opportunity with open arms. As their argument turns to a fight, we are left wondering if this is in fact the fight to end all fights. Will the sisters come to the same page and work for the pitch? Or will Happily Hitched disband for good?

programme.title: Arranged Family
programme.desc: Nikhil Solanki arrives at his in-laws' home, where a series of mishaps culminate in a significant blunder that upsets his father-in-law, Prakash Sharma. Both struggle to address the situation openly.

programme.title: The Mad House
programme.desc: Prakash avoids acknowledging that Nikhil damaged his car, instead blaming neighborhood children. Nikhil's attempts to rectify the situation lead to further complications.

programme.title: Conditions Apply
programme.desc: During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.

programme.title: Stuck In The Middle
programme.desc: A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

programme.title: Surprise, Surprise!
programme.desc: The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

programme.title: Spilling The Beans
programme.desc: The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

programme.title: House Of Cards
programme.desc: The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.

programme.title: Circle Of Life
programme.desc: The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

programme.title: Not Kidding
programme.desc: The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

programme.title: Here We Go Again
programme.desc: With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

programme.title: Zor Se Bolo
programme.desc: The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

programme.title: That's All Folks
programme.desc: The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

programme.title: Truth Bombs
programme.desc: The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

programme.title: The Damaad Test
programme.desc: The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

programme.title: Ladkiwale Vs. Ladkewale
programme.desc: While Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) are stuck in the agonizing "waiting period" of the CARA process, the tension shifts to the two sets of parents. The episode highlights that even when everyone agrees on the goal (the grandchild), their different ways of expressing love and anxiety can lead to a hilarious yet deep-seated cultural clash.

programme.title: Are We Ready?
programme.desc: The wait is over: Anita and Nikhil are matched with a child. However, instead of the pure euphoria they expected, they are hit with a wave of intense anxiety. The title "Are We Ready?" reflects the internal crisis the couple faces as they realize their lives are about to change irrevocably—not in nine months, but in a matter of days.

programme.title: What The Future?
programme.desc: The finale begins with the arrival of the moment Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) have spent the entire season preparing for: bringing their adopted daughter home. The episode isn't just about the new arrival, but about how each family member adapts to their "What The Future" role.

programme.title: Comfort Zone
programme.desc: Shaurya struggles with getting recognition for his efforts at work while Sanya debates shifting out of her home. Both of them help each other step out of their comfort zones and grow

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya shift in together, Sanya takes a gamble at work which impacts both of their lives.

programme.title: Emotion Or Logic
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya deal with the realization of having fallen for each other, they have to prioritize what is more important - emotions or logic?

programme.title: New Roles
programme.desc: Having finally admitted their feelings to each other, Shaurya and Sanya's honeymoon weekend is over and they must get back to reality. With Shaurya up for a promotion and Sanya doubtful about her growth in this company, what is this new couple in for?

programme.title: Milestones
programme.desc: With appraisals around the corner, Shaurya and Sanya brace themselves for the unexpected. Eventually, Shaurya gets his first real lesson in team management and Sanya makes a crucial decision to help her get what she wants.

programme.title: Month-Iversary
programme.desc: To mark 3 months of being together, Shaurya convinces Sanya to organise something for their "monthiversary." However, things begin to get complicated as Shaurya finds himself working directly with Sanya - for the first time since they started dating.

programme.title: Mr. White Mr. Black

programme.desc: This comedy-drama with an essence of romance is set in a four-day wedding in Rajasthan.

programme.title: Bajatey Raho
programme.desc: A hilarious con-comedy where a group of people decides to con the cunning businessman who is actually responsible for swindling them.

programme.title: Buddha Mar Gaya
programme.desc: When LK dies on the night before the IPO opens, the family decides to hide the death until the shares are all sold out.

programme.title: Sunday
programme.desc: Sunday is a Hindi comedy movie about Sehar who is unable to remember a particular Sunday in her life & then is suspected of a murder. A.C.P Rajveer takes up the case.

programme.title: Partner
programme.desc: Bhaskar who is in love with his boss Priya takes tips from "Love Guru" Prem, who believes he knows everything about women and way to their hearts. However, both of them keep failing to woo their ladies.

programme.title: Switchh
programme.desc: Stealing, speeding and doing it all in style. Get your heart racing as Vikrant Massey and gang plan the biggest con in #Switchh, now streaming only on #ErosNow.

programme.title: Halahal
programme.desc: The Murder of a college girl morphed into a suicide takes Dr. Shiv on a journey to dig the truth out of his daughter's murder.

programme.title: Love Possible
programme.desc: This is a love story of shrewd secretary and Childish boss and her friend who believes in settling down by marrying a rich person.

programme.title: Chalo Dilli
programme.desc: Chalo Dilli is a Hindi comedy movie about Mihika (Lara Dutta) who is an executive banker, who misses her flight to Delhi. Manu (Vinay Pathak), an auto-rickshaw driver tries to help Mihika to reach her destination.

programme.title: Four Two Ka One
programme.desc: 2 small-time crooks aspiring to make it big steal a bag which ensures them on a path that leads to them to the most hilarious and unexpected situations!

programme.title: Dekh Tamasha Dekh

programme.title: Haathi Mere Saathi
programme.desc: Watch the bond between humans & elephants with Bandev’s story as he fights for the protection of his ele-friends. Witness the rage on ‘Haathi Mere Saathi’, full movie streaming in Hindi on Eros Now.

programme.title: Gang
programme.desc: Four friends, lured by quick money, form a dangerous gang undertaking criminal activities all the while completely ignoring how it affects their personal relationships.

programme.title: Ki & Ka
programme.desc: A gender-bender role-reversal romantic drama, Ki & Ka is the story of an ambitious woman and her stay-at-home husband.

programme.title: Munna Michael
programme.desc: India's first ever dance-action film starring Tiger Shroff as a street dancer who turns dance guru for a gangster, Mahindar, played by Nawazuddin Siddiqui!

programme.title: Prahaar
programme.desc: An idealistic and patriotic army officer is shocked to see that the country he has fought for is going to the dogs.

programme.desc: Hai Golmaal In White House is a 1973 Indian Malayalam film, directed by Salar Shaikh. The film stars Rajpal Yadav, Govind Namdeo, Pratima Kazmi, Vijay Raaz, Yashpal Sharma in lead roles.

programme.title: Hota Hai Dil Pyaar Mein Paagal
programme.desc: Two friends fight it out to win the hand of the girl they love - and they will pull all stops to win her heart!

programme.desc: An NRI doctor Manu falls in love with the free-spirited and loud-mouth Tanu in this blockbuster rom-com starring Kangana Ranaut and R. Madhavan.

programme.title: Kambakkht Ishq
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a successful Indian stuntman who takes Hollywood by the storm but cannot find true love.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: Koyelaanchal is the story of Saryu Bhan Singh, a ruthless Mafioso and Nisheeth Kumar, an upright District Collector who face off in a most unusual way.

programme.title: Aa Dekhen Zara
programme.desc: A photographer has nothing going for him until he inherits a camera with an ability to predict the future but has to ultimately face the dark side of reality.

programme.title: Kashmir Daily
programme.desc: Kashmir Daily Story of a Journalist. It highlights the core problems faced by today's generation of Unemployment and Drugs. From the origin of humanity, it has always been a battle between Good and Evil.

programme.title: Shakal Pe Mat Ja
programme.desc: SPMJ is a story of 4 young boys who get caught up as suspects at the Delhi international airport, on a high alert day. They get caught while capturing an American Airlines aircraft landing on their camera.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 1
programme.desc: Kinjal enjoys the new suburban life while Kannan struggles to adjust. A techie Poojari comes over leaving them stunned.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 2
programme.desc: Kalpesh finally finds a smart and reliable help around the store, or at least we hope. Enters Bittu Amritraj!

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 3
programme.desc: Kalpesh wants to get into insurance business, but the problem arrives when he has to clear the Insurance licence exam.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 4
programme.desc: Kalpesh finds that selling insurance is harder than he imagined. Kalpesh decides to aggressively launch his company.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 5
programme.desc: A karaoke machine from the yard-sale rekindles Kalpesh's hidden passion of becoming a Bollywood singer.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 6
programme.desc: Payal and her partner decide to change their ladies salon to unisex. Inauguration goes a bit out of hand.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 7
programme.desc: The family gets on an all-vegetable juice diet plan which Kalpesh and Payal find difficult to follow.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 8
programme.desc: Kinjal starts attending birthing classes along with Kannan. Kalpesh meanwhile introduces the game of cricket to Pankaj.

programme.title: Metro Park S1 Ep 9
programme.desc: Kalpesh's house is falling apart with all the house repair work neglected for years, or at least Payal feels so.

programme.title: Sunday
programme.desc: Sunday is a Hindi comedy movie about Sehar who is unable to remember a particular Sunday in her life & then is suspected of a murder. A.C.P Rajveer takes up the case.

programme.title: Munna Michael
programme.desc: India's first ever dance-action film starring Tiger Shroff as a street dancer who turns dance guru for a gangster, Mahindar, played by Nawazuddin Siddiqui!

programme.title: Dekh Tamasha Dekh
programme.desc: A political satire based on a true story revolving around the search for the religious identity of a poor man crushed under the weight of a politician's hoarding.

programme.title: Shubh Mangal Saavdhan
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about Mudit and Sugandha, whose love is tested by an unexpected personal problem before their wedding.

programme.title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
programme.desc: A battle of good over evil ensues when a righteous cop sets out to rescue a village from the wrath of a cruel ruler.

programme.title: Halahal
programme.desc: The Murder of a college girl morphed into a suicide takes Dr. Shiv on a journey to dig the truth out of his daughter's murder.

programme.title: Always Kabhi Kabhi
programme.desc: The film revolves around four characters whose destinies seem to take them on different paths. Somehow, though, they all come together at St.Marks.

programme.title: Kiss Kis Ko
programme.desc: Amid rising interest in music groups, a group of young Indian men called Band of Boys set out to perform and build a career. However, facing a market that favors female performers, they must consider adding a woman to the band.

programme.title: Kaho Na Kaho
programme.desc: Kaho Na Kaho is a 2009 Romantic Drama movie directed & produced by Sanjay Niranjan. The film starred Tarun Khanna, Urvashi, Dinesh Hingoo, Rana Jung Bahadur, Shahbaz Khan in the lead role.

programme.title: Chalo Dilli
programme.desc: Chalo Dilli is a Hindi comedy movie about Mihika (Lara Dutta) who is an executive banker, who misses her flight to Delhi. Manu (Vinay Pathak), an auto-rickshaw driver tries to help Mihika to reach her destination.

programme.title: Haathi Mere Saathi
programme.desc: Watch the bond between humans & elephants with Bandev’s story as he fights for the protection of his ele-friends. Witness the rage on ‘Haathi Mere Saathi’, full movie streaming in Hindi on Eros Now.

programme.title: Daud

programme.title: Hum Tumhare Hain Sanam

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 1

programme.title: Flesh S1 Ep 2

programme.title: When Your Best Friend Gets Married
programme.desc: You’re excited, emotional, jealous, and proud all at once—the shift from daily friendship to occasional calls hits harder than expected.

programme.title: Signs You Have The Best Sister
programme.desc: The video shows the sweet and funny moments that prove you have the best sister. It highlights her support, teasing, and unconditional love that make the sibling bond so special.

programme.title: If Indian Moms Were Spies
programme.desc: The video imagines Indian moms with spy-like abilities — covertly listening, gathering info, and being always alert. It highlights the funny extremes of their awareness, intuition, and how nothing gets past them unnoticed.

programme.title: Every Cat Lover
programme.desc: This compilation video humorously contrasts the behaviors and quirks of dog lovers and cat lovers. The "Cat Lovers" segment features Madhu Gudi with her cat Goldy, showcasing typical cat behaviors like seeking attention, sitting on fans, and the unique bond between a cat and its owner

programme.title: When Dadi Is Your Bff
programme.desc: Your grandmother becomes your confidante, partner-in-crime, and emotional support — blurring generational lines. The video shows the fun, loyalty, and occasional friction in that special bond.

programme.title: When You Find The One
programme.desc: That magical, awkward, life-changing moment when you realize your partner might be “the one” — complete with butterflies, hesitation, overthinking, and emotional confession. The video balances realism with romantic idealism.

programme.title: Awkward Conversations With Dad
programme.desc: The “so what did you study?” “When will you settle down?” “Why aren’t you drinking less?” kind of dad-talk — full of pauses, sighs, and “fine, I’m fine”. The video captures the cringe and charm of talks with dad.

programme.title: When You're Expecting A Baby
programme.desc: The mood swings, cravings, excitement, panic, and sweet chaos of expecting parents navigating pregnancy together.

programme.title: Fashion Conversations With Your Sister
programme.desc: Two sisters (or siblings) talk fashion — from borrowing clothes, critiquing style choices, to fighting over accessories. It’s a mix of rivalry, admiration, and shared style secrets.

programme.title: Thoughts You Have While Waxing
programme.desc: The video humorously captures the funny, awkward, and sometimes painful thoughts that run through your mind while waxing. It highlights the relatable mix of dread, discomfort, and self-reflection during the process.

programme.title: Friendship: Then Vs Now
programme.desc: The video compares friendships in school/college days with how they are now. It highlights the nostalgia, changes, and the bond that still remains strong.

programme.title: When Your Bff Has Another Bff
programme.desc: The shift when your best friend starts spending more time with someone else; the strange mix of feeling replaced, missing your old dynamic, trying not to be jealous while still wanting to hang out with them.

programme.title: Certificate Of Nationalism
programme.desc: A satirical take on the idea that love for the country now comes with a “certificate” you must constantly prove.

programme.title: When Your Partner Loves You But Can't Express It
programme.desc: The video portrays relationships where one partner struggles to express love. It highlights the sweet, awkward, and heartfelt moments of unspoken affection.

programme.title: When You Realise Your Younger Sibling Has Grown Up
programme.desc: That surreal shift when your once-tiny sibling starts adulting—and you’re hit by nostalgia and pride.

programme.title: Things Bros Do
programme.desc: The video showcases the funny, quirky, and sometimes annoying things brothers typically do. It highlights the playful teasing, mischief, and unique bond shared between bros.

programme.title: We All Deserve A Boss Like Him
programme.desc: Here’s the boss who actually gets it: acknowledges your effort, cracks a joke when stress hits, listens when you complain—and makes coming to work less of a drag.

programme.title: If 90s Bollywood Romance Happened Today
programme.desc: The video imagines a 90s Bollywood-style romance—and shows how it would play out today with modern technology and social norms. It contrasts the dramatic, over-the-top declarations and music of old with how things like texting, social media, and everyday logistics change the romance vibe.

programme.title: When You Have A Crush On Your Boss Part 2
programme.desc: The series continues with awkward glances, mis-read messages and “Did they really mean that?!” moments as you try to navigate a crush on your boss in the office. All while pretending you’re just “team-meeting focused.”

programme.title: Holi Special: Story Of 4 Single Friends
programme.desc: The video shows four single friends celebrating Holi together. It highlights their fun, playful banter, and how friendship makes festivals special.

programme.title: Reconnecting With Your School Friends
programme.desc: After years apart, meeting school friends again brings nostalgia, awkwardness, comparisons (life, looks, careers), and the joy of remembering old stories. The video captures that mix of “I remember you” and “what happened to you.”

programme.title: Awkward Moments In College
programme.desc: The video humorously captures the everyday awkward situations students face in college. It highlights embarrassing encounters, funny slip-ups, and relatable campus moments.

programme.title: When Arts Student Falls For Science Student
programme.desc: A charming opposites-attract story that highlights the funny clashes between creativity and logic when an arts student dates a science student.

programme.title: Story Of Every Government Exam Student
programme.desc: A young aspirant juggles coaching, hopes and endless revisions while repeating “Next time for sure!” with every attempt. The video captures the roller-coaster of determination, procrastination and exam stress.

programme.title: Things Only Girl Best Friends Do
programme.desc: From matching outfits, inside jokes, sister-level honesty, to secret plans and shared playlists — this video showcases how girl best friends operate in their own world. Full of loyalty, giggles and codewords.

programme.title: When You're Single And Your Friends Are Dating
programme.desc: The video humorously portrays the dynamics when you're single and your friends are in relationships. It highlights the feeling of being the "third wheel" and the humorous situations that arise from it.

programme.title: Indians At A Tailor Shop
programme.desc: The video portrays the typical experiences and interactions one has when visiting a tailor shop in India. It highlights the common scenarios, misunderstandings, and amusing moments that occur during such visits.

programme.title: Struggles Of Having Long Hair
programme.desc: From endless tangles to hair-in-everything problems—a funny look at the pain of long locks.

programme.title: Planning Your First Time
programme.desc: A funny yet honest portrayal of the nervousness, overthinking, and awkward planning that come with preparing for your “first time.”

programme.title: Things Newly Married Couples Do
programme.desc: This video explores the relatable and often humorous experiences of couples after getting married and the honeymoon phase is over. It highlights the changes in dynamics as they transition from being boyfriend/girlfriend to husband and wife.

programme.title: If Doctors Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A hilarious peek into what would happen if doctors could hear every anxious, dramatic, or random thought their patients have during check-ups.

programme.title: If Exam Subjects Were People
programme.desc: Math, Science, English, and History as human personalities—some annoying, some fun, and all too relatable.

programme.title: When A Topper Falls In Love With A Backbencher
programme.desc: The academic world collides with romance: one’s always ahead in class, the other’s lagging behind — yet hearts beat anyway. The video shows how opposites in studies find common ground in love.

programme.title: 8 Ways Your Partner Drives You Mad

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

The only trouble is, he doesn’t know how to sail. Ellis struggles with the physical and mental challenges of sailing but with help from friends both old and new, he finds his sea legs and sets off on his quest.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest
programme.desc: The Marshall Islands have a long human history, but it is the more recent saga that was thrust upon them during World War II and its aftermath that draws host Ellis Emmett to its shores. Following the Allied victory, the United States moved the local inhabitants from their quiet paradise in order to conduct atomic bomb testing at the famous Bikini Atoll. Ellis explores how, almost 65 years later, both the people and environment continue to be affected.

programme.title: The New Detectives S1
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects’ fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: Diagnosis Unknown
programme.desc: After a nurse treats five cases of pneumonia in a single night outside of Roanoke, Virginia, she notifies local health officials. Tests confirm that the patients have contracted Legionnaire's disease, an acute and often deadly form of pneumonia that spreads and escalates rapidly. A week later, a 50-year-old man is dead and there are a total of 15 confirmed cases. Testing by the CDC reveals that all of the patients are infected with the same strain of bacteria. This can only mean one thing, an outbreak. People in the community are hysterical. Local and federal health authorities scramble to find the origin in order to prevent further infections.

programme.title: World Of Travel S2
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger venture beyond the mountains to explore the vibrant soul of South Africa, from the high-adrenaline wild of Kruger National Park to the trailblazing spirit of its first Black-owned winery. The journey begins in Mpumalanga, 'the place where the sun rises,' for an immersive safari experience in Kruger National Park. Accompanied by their daughter, Kynsley, the team experiences nature’s masterpiece firsthand, discovering that the 'wild' is as much about preservation as it is about the thrill of discovery. The narrative then shifts to Cape Town, a global cosmopolitan hub where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet. Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: For most people, their wedding day ignites dreams of a bright future and the hope of fading into the sunset with the one they love. But for some brides and grooms, the reality of 'til death do you part' hits come sooner than expected.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling- Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares…and in the minds of serial killers. Renowned FBI profiler Robert Ressler can reveal unseen clues about a killer simply by learning details about the crime. From motives to habits, social traits to taste in cards, investigative profiling discloses a killer’s hidden motives.

programme.title: Diagnosis Unknown
programme.desc: Health officials in Albuquerque, New Mexico face an outbreak of a rare and fatal blood disorder. Patients suffer sharp muscular pain, fatigue, fever and rashes. Twenty-one people die from the illness. Five other states report similar cases. The epidemic is spreading. The Center for Disease Control assists federal and state health officials in their hunt for the cause. After six months of relentless investigation, researchers unravel the mystery. Those who suffered the illness have inadvertently given it to themselves. A contaminated batch of a dietary supplement sold in health food stores across the country is the culprit.

programme.title: Diagnosis Unknown
programme.desc: In late August of 1999, an infectious disease specialist in Queens, New York reports that she has two elderly patients with neurological disorders. More cases crop up in the following days, several patients die. Initial tests confirm that New York has been hit by an outbreak of the mosquito-borne illness, St. Louis encephalitis. Nearly a month later, exotic birds begin to die at the Bronx Zoo. Zoo officials discover they have been infected with West Nile, a virus never before diagnosed in the Western Hemisphere. With this new information, epidemiologists studying the cases of St. Louis encephalitis are lead to a different and shocking conclusion, the virus is spreading to humans.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology- Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life. The kinds of insects on bodies, along with their stage of development, can pinpoint time of death and help identify victims.

programme.title: Diagnosis Unknown
programme.desc: On the tiny resort island of Martha’s Vineyard, landscaper, Patrick Ryer, suffers from chills and high fever. Patrick has contracted Tularemia, a rare bacterial disease. Health officials alert residents and tourists who crowd the Vineyard over the summer holiday. Over the next month, ten more people are diagnosed with the disease, including other landscapers and children. Medical investigators from the Center for Disease Control and state officials search for a common link. Tularemia is so infectious that it is on the government’s watch list of biological weapons. Based on the number of people infected, officials quickly rule out terrorism, but none of the cases appear to be related. All they are able to determine is that most of the victims have outdoor occupations such as landscaping and construction. The findings mark the first time landscaping has been named as a risk factor for the disease.

programme.desc: Forensic Entomology- Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life. The kinds of insects on bodies, along with their stage of development, can pinpoint time of death and help identify victims.

programme.title: Diagnosis Unknown
programme.desc: On the tiny resort island of Martha’s Vineyard, landscaper, Patrick Ryer, suffers from chills and high fever. Patrick has contracted Tularemia, a rare bacterial disease. Health officials alert residents and tourists who crowd the Vineyard over the summer holiday. Over the next month, ten more people are diagnosed with the disease, including other landscapers and children. Medical investigators from the Center for Disease Control and state officials search for a common link. Tularemia is so infectious that it is on the government’s watch list of biological weapons. Based on the number of people infected, officials quickly rule out terrorism, but none of the cases appear to be related. All they are able to determine is that most of the victims have outdoor occupations such as landscaping and construction. The findings mark the first time landscaping has been named as a risk factor for the disease.

programme.title: Diagnosis Unknown
programme.desc: A hospital in Walkerton, Ontario is flooded with patients with the same alarming symptoms. All suffer from fever, nausea and gastrointestinal problems. Health officials suspect water contamination, but the Public Utilities Commission (PUC) reports that the water is safe. The next day, 20 more patients are admitted with the same symptoms. Health officials determine E. Coli bacteria is contaminating the drinking water and warn the public. Bottled water is handed out to residents. In order to stop the epidemic, health officials must locate the source. Before the outbreak is stopped, four adults and an infant die from the deadly bacteria.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Missing Person- Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples. In addition to pictures on milk cartons, store windows, and in mass mailings, authorities use nationwide computer databases to help locate missing persons or match them with unidentified bodies. Even so, many of the missing are never seen again.

programme.title: Diagnosis Unknown
programme.desc: In the summer of 2001, Debby Stoner’s family begins to exhibit severe flu like symptoms. Upon visiting the family, who live in a small village on Maui, doctors discover that others are also suffering from strange symptoms including headaches, fevers and a bizarre red rash. Health officials are concerned they are dealing with a terrifying virus that is spread by mosquitoes. It is an outbreak of Dengue Fever, imported to the island by travelers from Tahiti. The disease has the potential to spread to other islands and eventually the mainland. In a matter of days, more cases are reported in towns nearby. Without a vaccine or cure, the only option for health officials is to track the virus and eradicate the source, wherever it is found.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains- It’s difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence. But what happens when the charred remains are found, unrecognizable, seemingly impossible to identify? Dr. John Verano and Dr. Doug Owsley of the Smithsonian have faced these challenges, identifying the burned remains of two American journalists found in Guatemala seven years after their reported disappearance. It seems as though fire can unveil lies, as well as conceal truths.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 Ep4 Untouched Atolls
programme.desc: Just off the coast of Africa is a strip of 115 islands called the Seychelles. Originally claimed by France in the 1700s most of the population speak French and the influence is felt in its cuisine. The Seychelles happen to have some of the best saltwater fly fishing and Mario educates his audience as to how to fish these reefs. This is an extreme Flyfishing adventure in a location that can only be described as magical. Species like GT's, bonefish, milk fish are also caught for fun and Mario even attempts to swim with sailfish to get you up close and personal to one of the words most iconic predatorial fish.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 Ep4 Untouched Atolls
programme.desc: Just off the coast of Africa is a strip of 115 islands called the Seychelles. Originally claimed by France in the 1700s most of the population speak French and the influence is felt in its cuisine. The Seychelles happen to have some of the best saltwater fly fishing and Mario educates his audience as to how to fish these reefs. This is an extreme Flyfishing adventure in a location that can only be described as magical. Species like GT's, bonefish, milk fish are also caught for fun and Mario even attempts to swim with sailfish to get you up close and personal to one of the words most iconic predatorial fish.

programme.title: Dead Meat S1 Ep7 Florida Gator Hunt
programme.desc: Florida is a prime location for the Dead Meat show. The state is loaded with invasive creatures like lionfish, snakeheads, pythons and iguanas. And they have a few alligators as well. The country surrounding the fisherman's paradise of Lake Okeechobee is home to more than a couple gators. Scott Leysath has cooked lots of gator meat, but this is his first hunt.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 Ep5 Heartbreak Tuna
programme.desc: When two oceans collide, there is mayhem on the horizon. On this episode Mario ventures off the coast of Cape Town where the Indian ocean meets the Atlantic. The two colliding water temperatures and currents causes the yellow fin tuna to come in hordes and he finds himself in a David vs Goliath battle with his food. It is of the upmost importance than he can select his fish and only one at a time line caught, which sounds easy in theory.... but nature has something else in mind for him.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 Ep6 Getting Close To Black Death
programme.desc: Deep in the wilderness of Northern South Africa, poaching is rife, and the wilderness is as dangerous as it gets. Mario attempts to be the first person in the area to have ever harvested one of the most dangerous animals known to Africa, the Cape buffalo also known by locals as ""Black Death"". By risking his life Mario is determined to harvest this beast so he can donate the meat to the Anti-poaching units who are on the front line, saving endangered animals daily. As most of the bounty is used to feed the conservationists, he reserves a shank for himself as he is keen to create a hearty dish of Osso Bucco.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1 Ep6 Getting Close To Black Death
programme.desc: Deep in the wilderness of Northern South Africa, poaching is rife, and the wilderness is as dangerous as it gets. Mario attempts to be the first person in the area to have ever harvested one of the most dangerous animals known to Africa, the Cape buffalo also known by locals as ""Black Death"". By risking his life Mario is determined to harvest this beast so he can donate the meat to the Anti-poaching units who are on the front line, saving endangered animals daily. As most of the bounty is used to feed the conservationists, he reserves a shank for himself as he is keen to create a hearty dish of Osso Bucco.

programme.title: Budhwaar
programme.desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

programme.title: Bandage
programme.desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Bhool
programme.desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Divorce Celebration
programme.desc: While staging a sarcastic pre-divorce photoshoot, a couple is forced to confront the memories and emotions that prove their love isn’t as over as they thought.

programme.title: Prem Patra
programme.desc: In 1970s India, Sakshi, a curious college girl, stumbles upon a hidden envelope under a garden bench while searching for a dropped coin. Inside is a nameless, heartfelt love letter. Drawn in by its mystery, Sakshi returns the next day—only to find a new letter, this time from the lover’s other half. What begins as a fleeting curiosity becomes a quiet obsession, as Sakshi discovers an untold romance between two people separated by caste and family expectations. When their letter exchange abruptly ends, Sakshi, desperate to see love triumph, writes a reply pretending to be the man. But the woman senses the lie—his scent is missing—and in heartbreak, tears the letter away. Left in disappointment, Sakshi returns once more—only to find a young man with a plastered leg searching under the same bench. Is he the one from the letters? Or just another coincidence?

programme.title: Goals
programme.desc: As Meera, our pretty in pink protagonist comes back to Bombay after spending several months apart from her beau Ranbir, the circumstances force them to evaluate the basis of their relationship. This film is a deep dive into a young adult's core problems of emotional dishonesty and preference of style over substance.

programme.title: Dubki
programme.desc: Dubki is a story based on a true incident of a female constable in male-dominated law enforcement. Despite being a tough and dominant constable at the Lalkurti police station, Ganga Yadav was troubled several times by SHO Durgesh Mishra. Ganga complained about it to the IPS officer and asked for a transfer; however, he refused to help her. The female constable was left with no other choice but to take justice into her own hands.

programme.title: Firni
programme.desc: The next-door neighbors are having a fight and they send their rude 14-year-old daughter Firni to keep her busy.

programme.title: Dwand
programme.desc: Ruby, a lower-middle-class girl was made to believe that she is beautiful, intelligent, and different and that she deserves a worthy husband. She completed her studies and wanted to be a career girl. However, the marriage happened contrary to her expectations with a traditional man Vivek of the similar lower middle-class strata. After giving birth to a girl child she revolted and joined an advertising company to shape up her career. Here begins the nightmare.

programme.title: Duty
programme.desc: Different classes in society are intertwined, with each person's actions impacting others. When individuals from various classes fulfil their responsibilities, stability is achieved. This story explores fairness and the expression of duty among people from different social strata.

programme.title: Cycle Of Sorrows
programme.desc: Set in a rural village, this heart-wrenching story follows a poor father with a beloved daughter, who still yearns for a son as his pregnant wife prepares to give birth. Driven by financial hardship, he makes a tragic decision that not only shatters his family but leaves his relationship with his daughter and wife forever scarred. Watch this emotional tale of a father’s regret and the lasting impact on his family. Can he undo the damage he’s caused?

programme.title: Electric Piya
programme.desc: A high school girl brings a new bulb for her study lamp. The bulb is anthropomorphic and he is exultant and joyful for having the luck of lighting for her. As he lights, he falls in love with the young girl.

programme.title: Didi!
programme.desc: Imagine waking up to an annoying alarm sound. Familiar? Now imagine waking up to someone else's alarm! Why isn't anyone shutting it? Find out what happens when an annoyed brother wakes up to his sister's loud alarm and storms to her room only to find it empty.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Foul
programme.desc: Against the setting of a journey to Thailand, Ayush, a lustful businessman, possesses both the capability and cleverness to be unfaithful to his wife and shatter her aspirations of moving to Canada. Yet, the question remains: Can he thwart her pursuit of realizing her dreams?

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: Complaint
programme.desc: A journey of a 12-year-old girl who visits the police station to report the disappearance of her bicycle. At the station, a police officer undertakes a heartwarming action to restore the child's trust, earning the admiration and faith of all those present. This incident serves as a powerful testament to our inherent, albeit sometimes unquestioning, belief in the police force.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

Fearing the unreal powers he suddenly acquires, he hurries out. How does a young woman who walks in right then change Sameer's attitude towards the magical doughnut?

programme.title: Faatima
programme.desc: Faatima is a story of two unknown individuals who meet each other for the first time at a cafe and share with each other some very interesting facts only to make us realize that good souls do exist.

programme.title: Firki
programme.desc: It's the way many father's typically behave when their children start driving. The idea of using the navigation tool to highlight the generation gap is also based on my own life experience. The title is Firki because the family is spinning around like a Firki without having reached their destination in the film. It's also depicts how they've been taken for a ride by the navigation app, or as we say in Hindi....Firki le li

programme.title: Faboo
programme.desc: Are we using social media to expand our horizon or are we overusing it and unknowingly desensitizing ourselves. Faboo explores this aspect of social media and nudges us to think about it through this story of a mother and son.

programme.title: Fear Of Wheels

As a person reaches a certain stage in life, they observe numerous things happening around them, yet feel incapable of taking action. Over time, they become reliant on others even for the most basic tasks. This narrative portrays those individuals who experience old age gradually tightening its grip around them.

Their marriage is a compromise, as they do not see the spouse of their imagination in each other. Mohan who gets fascinated seeing taller women realizes the same about his wife. He decides to go to a red light area to fulfill his desire. But does he do it?

Despite their differing opinions, both stand firm in their convictions. When an issue deeply troubles the wife, she bravely advocates for justice. After a prolonged battle, legal verdict is achieved. Yet, uncertainties linger about the truth behind this justice, leaving the tale shrouded in ambiguity.

He's initially captivated by the village's beauty but soon confronts a harsh reality: the mistreatment of a lower-caste boy by the villagers. This revelation shocks him, leading to his determined fight for the boy's rights. The overarching question remains: can he succeed in this battle between humanity and caste discrimination?

programme.desc: Even in this modern era, there are several religious conflicts around us. We start judging a stranger based on his/her religion or culture. This short film is a humble attempt trying to reduce the distance between religions and thereby portraying religious bondage.

programme.title: Cheepatakadumpa
programme.desc: ‘CHEEPATAKADUMPA’ follows three women over less than a day as they awaken their naughty teenage alter egos when they meet again after years, unleashing mischief on each other, and in turn on the biased patriarchal belief systems of the world they were born into. In a masculine culture that is unduly serious about making the rules that women are expected to live by, Teja, Santo and Tamanna find true and happy rebellion in the gasping throes of this mischief.

programme.title: Date Night
programme.desc: A meticulously planned date night goes terribly wrong when the husband reveals that he will not be able to make it.

The Goons are Brutal on them and it seems that there is no way out until the protagonist thinks of a supernatural idea.

programme.title: Dry Dreams
programme.desc: We mostly don’t care about things, which we have around us and are easily available here’s one such thrilling short film about a guy who has two visitors asking for water, what happens next is an eye opener.

programme.title: Dadi Ka Murabba
programme.desc: Ramesh dreams of a good job but his lack of fluent English hinders him. His Dadi advises him to be self-reliant, prompting him to sell murabba with her help. His business grows, and he asked to raise the flag at his old school on Independence Day. The sarpanch tells him that as a self-reliant young individual, Ramesh can add to the nation's growth. The film shows that it takes both an individual's grit and determination and the support of loved ones to achieve the impossible.

programme.title: Firefly
programme.desc: A chance encounter with a piece from his past, leads Ved, a young man to reminisce a fateful night with his girlfriend, Daaria.

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk
programme.desc: Dawn to Dusk tells the narrative of Nisha Rawat, a young girl who lost her parents. She has skin cancer, Malignant Melanoma and her entire life revolves around the night. Nisha accepted her circumstances as they were. Her life, however, is turned upside down when she meets Suraj, a boy who works at a hospital. Dawn to Dusk becomes Nisha and Suraj's narrative.

programme.title: Dhongbaaz
programme.desc: Upon learning about his bride's unfaithfulness, an anguished groom delves into her past to uncover the truth, all while the wedding guests impatiently await his return.

programme.title: Dream Ride
programme.desc: Dream Ride is an emotional road drama about two strangers, Rajat and Raashi, whose unexpected journey together changes their perspective on life. What begins as a mistaken cab ride gradually unfolds into a heartfelt story of failures, dreams, self-discovery, and second chances. Through humor, honest conversations, and emotional moments along the way, the journey becomes more than just travel — it becomes a rediscovery of hope and the courage to begin again.

programme.title: Silent Cycle
programme.desc:
In a modest Indian household, 12-year-old Vrinda navigates the complexities of gender roles, tradition, and her own budding adolescence. Playful and spirited, she finds herself abruptly thrust into the adult world when she experiences her first menstruation during a Navratri puja. Caught between her grandmother Lata's strict adherence to tradition and her mother Aruna's sympathetic but conflicted support, Vrinda confronts the taboo surrounding menstruation and the use of unsanitary cloth rags.
Determined to change her circumstances, Vrinda takes matters into her own hands, discovering sanitary pads with the help of her younger brother, Jai. However, her newfound confidence is met with resistance from Lata, who views such modern conveniences as unnecessary expenses. This sparks a poignant clash of generations within the family, as Vrinda bravely challenges the stigma surrounding menstruation and advocates for her own health and dignity.
As tensions rise, the family's unity is tested during the Dussehra festival. In a symbolic gesture of reconciliation and progress, Vrinda, Lata, and Aruna come together to burn the effigy of Ravana, marking a small yet significant step towards breaking free from regressive traditions.

programme.title: Happily Married Part 2
programme.desc: Rani & Animesh, a couple who is having an affair with Jimmy plan to meet him on Saturday. The story unfolds as their meeting with Jimmy doesn’t go as planned.

programme.title: Half Cake
programme.desc: HALF CAKE is about a single mother who struggles to earn extra wages to fulfil an innocent ask of a cake from her only son. Beyond the cake, it's a tale of innocence and resilience that will touch your heart.

programme.title: Just Take It Easy
programme.desc: The story is basically on internal happiness. Sanjay a businessman is the CEO of Oberoi Industries. He is not happy in his life. Despite having all the materialistic pleasure not happy internally. The company celebrates its success party on its high growth. Sanjay invites a model Priyanka, his girlfriend to the party. He promises her to make the face of Oberoi Industries.

programme.title: Funkaar
programme.desc: A heart-warming tale of a mother who rediscovers her passion for her craft when her daughter pushes her beyond the confines of her daily routine.

programme.title: Jama Punji
programme.desc: A late night conversation between a mother (Sarla) & her son Anshuman, 13 days after the passing of his father where they discuss the reasons for his detachment with his father and how by the end of the night, certain events lead Anshuman to accept and make amends with his deceased father.

programme.title: Harela
programme.desc: A 60-year-old woman and a young man navigate tradition and modernity during the festival in Uttarakhand. Who will uphold their heritage in an evolving world?

But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Hack-her
programme.desc: Shraddha, about to leave for America through a Corporate that is currently under attack by a hacker, who is on run by the police and is currently on every news channel. Between all this is Vishesh, who truly loves Shraddha, and now even she is going, just like his parents, leaving him all alone. But not everything we see is true, a hacker on a mission, a girl with ambitions, and a lover, sounds good right? But who is who? Do we know the entire truth? Find out everything in our upcoming short film "Hack-Her"

They buried Aaron, symbolizing a new beginning. As they prepared to flee, Ava's past caught up with them, leading to another gunshot as they escaped, with the haunting "Behri Duniya" playing on.

His friend tells him that people smile whenever you point it towards them. He soon realizes the same and gets all thrilled to spread smiles including his mother. Unfortunately, the camera gets lost and all his dreams get shattered. What happens next is the core of the film. The story revolves around the perception of a small kid who wants to follow his dreams.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Hum Types
